# Feature: Persistent UI During Task Operations with Backend Sync Indicator

## Overview
Currently, moving or reordering a task card triggers `fetchTasks()`, which sets `loading = true`. Because `KanbanBoard.jsx` conditionally renders `<div className="loading-spinner">Loading Kanban Board...</div>` whenever `loading` is true, the entire Kanban board unmounts and disappears for up to 2 seconds (exacerbated by the realistic 20–2000 ms API latency introduced in Sprint 3.3). This jarring layout flash disrupts the user's focus and drag-and-drop workflow. Furthermore, during inline status changes or modal saves, there is no visual feedback indicating whether the backend has persisted the change or if synchronization is still underway.

This feature ensures that:
1. The full-page loading screen displays **only** during initial data fetching (when opening the app or fetching initial tasks/projects).
2. When moving, reordering, updating, or deleting tasks, the UI **remains persistent and fully interactive** (no unmounting, no layout destruction).
3. A sleek, non-intrusive **Backend Sync Indicator** displays real-time synchronization states:
   - 🔄 **Syncing**: Active API call in flight (e.g. *"Updating task...", "Saving changes..."*).
   -  **Saved**: Succeeded and confirmed by the backend (e.g. *"Changes saved"*, fading out after 2.5 seconds).
   - ⚠️ **Offline / Queued**: Network error or offline queue fallback (e.g. *"Saved offline"*).

## User Stories
- **As a user**, I want the Kanban board to remain in place when I drag and drop cards so that the screen does not abruptly flash a loading spinner.
- **As a user**, I want to see a clear visual indicator showing that my task updates are actively saving and successfully persisted to the backend.
- **As a user with network latency**, I want immediate optimistic UI responsiveness while keeping track of backend sync status.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
1. **`client/src/components/SyncIndicator.jsx`** (New Component):
   - Renders a status badge/pill with `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"`.
   - Supports states:
     - `idle`: Hidden or unobtrusive.
     - `syncing`: Displays a micro-spinner or pulsing dot icon + customizable message (e.g., *"Saving changes..."*).
     - `saved`: Displays a checkmark icon + *"All changes saved"*, automatically transitioning back to `idle` after a timeout (2500 ms).
     - `offline`: Displays a cloud-off or alert icon + *"Saved offline"*.
   - Accepts props: `{ status, message }` or connects via a sync state hook.
2. **`client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`** (Refactor):
   - Replace single `loading` state with `initialLoading` (true only on first fetch before initial data is populated) and `syncState` (`{ status: "idle" | "syncing" | "saved" | "offline", message: string }`).
   - Enhance `fetchTasks({ silent = false })`:
     - When `silent === true`: Fetches tasks without toggling `initialLoading`, updating `tasks` state seamlessly in the background.
     - When `silent === false`: Sets `initialLoading = true` on first mount.
   - Refactor `handleDropTask`:
     - Keep optimistic local reorder.
     - Set `syncState` to `{ status: "syncing", message: "Updating card order..." }`.
     - Await `taskApi.reorderTask(...)`.
     - Perform silent background `fetchTasks({ silent: true })` to reconcile normalized positions without unmounting.
     - On success: set `syncState` to `{ status: "saved", message: "Order saved" }`.
     - On catch / offline: set `syncState` to `{ status: "offline", message: "Saved offline" }`.
   - Refactor `handleStatusChange`:
     - Trigger `syncState` transition (`syncing` → `saved` / `offline`).
   - Refactor `handleSaveTask`:
     - Trigger `syncState` transition during create/update.
   - Refactor `handleConfirmDelete`:
     - Trigger `syncState` transition during task deletion.
   - Embed `<SyncIndicator status={syncState.status} message={syncState.message} />` in the board header alongside `.board-stats`.
3. **`client/src/index.css`** (Styles):
   - Add `.sync-indicator` and status modifier classes (`.sync-syncing`, `.sync-saved`, `.sync-offline`) in the Loading & Notifications section.
   - Use design system tokens (`--bg-secondary`, `--border-color`, `--radius-pill`, `--accent-primary`, `--color-success`, `--color-warning`).
   - Add subtle keyframe animations (`spin` and `fadeIn`).

### Data Model (Mock)
Sync state representation in React:
```js
{
	status: "idle" | "syncing" | "saved" | "offline",
	message: "Saving changes..."
}
```

Sample transitions during task drop:
```js
// 1. User drops task card
setSyncState({ status: "syncing", message: "Updating task position..." })
// 2. Optimistic UI updates immediately in tasks state (no board unmount)
// 3. API request finishes
setSyncState({ status: "saved", message: "Position updated" })
// 4. Timer (2500ms) clears status back to "idle"
```

### Simulated Backend
Compatible with the 20–2000 ms random latency wrapper (`apiClient.js`):
- While `taskApi.reorderTask()` or `taskApi.updateTask()` is in flight (20–2000 ms), the sync indicator visibly displays the `syncing` state with a subtle animated spinner while the board remains completely interactive.
- When the API resolves, the indicator updates to `saved` for 2.5 seconds before cleanly disappearing.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. **Create `client/src/components/SyncIndicator.jsx`**:
   - Import Lucide icons: `Check`, `Loader2`, `CloudOff`.
   - Implement component rendering appropriate icon and text based on `status`.
   - Add `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"` for accessibility.
   - Ensure header comment `// Generated by Gemini 3.6 Flash on 2026-09-04`, tabs, CRLF, Biome `asNeeded`.
2. **Add CSS styles in `client/src/index.css`**:
   - Define `.sync-indicator`, `.sync-indicator.syncing`, `.sync-indicator.saved`, `.sync-indicator.offline`.
   - Add `.sync-spinner` with CSS animation `@keyframes spin`.
   - Ensure styles match the existing dark/light mode CSS variables and `.stat-pill` styling.
3. **Update `client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`**:
   - Separate `initialLoading` from background sync:
     ```js
     const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = useState(true)
     const [syncState, setSyncState] = useState({ status: "idle", message: "" })
     ```
   - Update `fetchTasks`:
     ```js
     const fetchTasks = useCallback(async ({ silent = false } = {}) => {
         if (!silent) setInitialLoading(true)
         try {
             const data = await taskApi.getTasks()
             setTasks(data)
             setUseFallback(false)
         } catch (err) {
             ...
         } finally {
             if (!silent) setInitialLoading(false)
         }
     }, [])
     ```
   - In `handleDropTask`:
     - Set syncing state before calling API.
     - Await `taskApi.reorderTask(...)`.
     - Call `await fetchTasks({ silent: true })`.
     - Transition to saved state on success, or offline state on network error.
   - In `handleStatusChange`:
     - Set syncing state before calling API.
     - Await `taskApi.updateTask(...)`.
     - Transition to saved state on success, or offline state on network error.
   - In `handleSaveTask`:
     - Wrap API update/create with syncing and saved state transitions.
   - In `handleConfirmDelete`:
     - Wrap API delete with syncing and saved state transitions.
   - Replace `if (loading) return ...` with `if (initialLoading) return ...`.
   - Render `<SyncIndicator status={syncState.status} message={syncState.message} />` inside `.board-stats` or as a top bar indicator in the board view.
4. **Ensure Projects Loading Screen is Preserved**:
   - Verify `ProjectsPage.jsx` continues to show `Loading projects...` when fetching projects initially.
   - Verify initial fetch in `KanbanBoard` continues to show `Loading Kanban Board...`.
5. **Code Style & Formatting**:
   - Run `cd client && pnpm check` and `pnpm format` to ensure zero Biome diagnostics.
   - Test build with `pnpm build`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Initial page load displays the loading indicator when fetching tasks and projects.
- [ ] Dragging and dropping tasks between columns or within columns NEVER causes the board to unmount or show the full-screen loading spinner.
- [ ] Modifying a task status via card dropdown or modal editor NEVER causes the board to unmount or show the full-screen loading spinner.
- [ ] A visible `SyncIndicator` indicates when backend updates are in progress (`syncing`), confirms successful saves (`saved` for ~2.5s), and indicates offline queued operations (`offline`).
- [ ] The sync indicator integrates with the CSS design system (Dark & Light mode compatible, smooth animations, accessible ARIA attributes).
- [ ] `cd client && pnpm check` and `cd client && pnpm build` pass with zero errors.
- [ ] File header comment `// Generated by Gemini 3.6 Flash on 2026-09-04` present on all modified and new frontend files.
